column1: REGISTRATION  OF  TITLE ACT, No.  21 OF  1998
Declaration  of  Determination  of  the  Commissioner  of  Title  Settlement  under  Section  14
BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, I, the undersigned, hereby de-
clare my determination as set out in the Schedule appended hereto in regard to the  title to parcel of Land No. 2 of Block 03, contained
in the Cadastral Map No. 330300, situated in the Village of Mallanda within the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 460 F- Mallanda in
the Divisional Secretary's Division of Kothmale, in the District of Nuwaraeliya, in the Province of Central, referred to in Notice No.
33/0002 calling for claims to land parcels which was duly published in the Gazette No. 1705/15 of 22nd November, 2011 in terms of
Section 12 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998.
